zh_CN: 唔……隆司，你这算哪门子恶作剧呀？
en: Mm... Ryuji, what kind of prank is that supposed to be?

zh_CN: 哎呀……有点痒啦，别闹。
en: Oh... that tickles. Stop fooling around.

zh_CN: ……哼，想拿这招逗我？还早呢。
en: ...Hmph. You think that will tease me? Not yet.

zh_CN: 嗯？……再这么胡闹，我可要扣分了哦。
en: Hmm?... Keep fooling around like that and I’ll deduct points.

zh_CN: 嗯……慢慢来嘛，我又不会跑。
en: Mm... take your time. I’m not going anywhere.

zh_CN: 呵……还挺会哄人的嘛，隆司。
en: Heh... you do know how to sweet-talk me, Ryuji.

zh_CN: 唔……就这样……再贴近一点。
en: Mm... just like that... a little closer.

zh_CN: 嗯……今天倒挺守规矩的嘛……
en: Mm... you’re behaving yourself today...

zh_CN: 啊……等、等一下……呼吸都乱了……
en: Ah... w-wait... I can’t catch my breath...

zh_CN: 唔……偏偏挑我最没辙的地方……
en: Mm... you just had to pick the places I’m weakest...

zh_CN: 嗯……别、别笑话我……是你太狡猾了……
en: Mm... d-don’t laugh at me... you’re the one playing dirty...

zh_CN: 哈啊……再这样下去……换我要招架不住了……
en: Hah... keep this up... and I’ll be the one who can’t take it...

zh_CN: 啊啊……隆司……你、你故意的吧……
en: Ahh... Ryuji... y-you’re doing that on purpose, aren’t you...

zh_CN: 嗯……坏心眼……明明知道我受不了这个……
en: Mm... you tease... you know I can’t handle that...

zh_CN: 唔……不、不许停……再多给我一点……
en: Mm... d-don’t stop... give me a little more...

zh_CN: 哈啊……真是败给你了……随你怎样都行啦……
en: Hah... you win... do whatever you want...

zh_CN: 唔……嗯……嘴唇……还要……
en: Mm... mm... my lips... more...

zh_CN: 哈……连、连让我顶嘴的空档都不给呀……
en: Hah... you won’t even give me a chance to talk back...

zh_CN: 唔……脸颊发烫了啦……别一直逗我。
en: Mm... my cheeks are burning... stop teasing me so much.

zh_CN: 嗯……总觉得被你当成小姑娘哄了……
en: Mm... I feel like you’re doting on me like a young girl...

zh_CN: 啊……脖子……唔、那里一碰就发软了……
en: Ah... my neck... mm, just touching there makes me weak...

zh_CN: 哈啊……隆司……连声音都压不住了……
en: Hah... Ryuji... I can’t even keep my voice down...

zh_CN: 唔……胸口……心跳快得都要被你察觉了……
en: Mm... my chest... my heart’s beating so fast you’ll notice...

zh_CN: 嗯……别光顾着欺负这里嘛……
en: Mm... don’t spend all your time teasing me there...

zh_CN: 呀……！……那、那里太敏锐了啦……
en: Ah...!... Th-that’s too sensitive...

zh_CN: 啊啊……唔……腰、腰都要麻掉了……
en: Ahh... mm... my hips are going numb...

zh_CN: 唔……肚子这边……痒痒的啦。
en: Mm... my belly... that tickles.

zh_CN: 呵……连这里也不放过呀？
en: Heh... you won’t leave even this spot alone?

zh_CN: 嗯……后背都跟着发热了……
en: Mm... even my back feels hot...

zh_CN: 呼……慢慢来……这样很舒服……
en: Hah... slowly... that feels good...

zh_CN: 啊……！……隆司，别突然这么欺负那里……
en: Ah...!... Ryuji, don’t suddenly tease me there like that...

zh_CN: 唔……等、等一下……那里已经一塌糊涂了……
en: Mm... w-wait... I’m already a mess down there...

zh_CN: 啊……大腿……力气都被你抽光了……
en: Ah... my thighs... you’re draining all my strength...

zh_CN: 唔……再往上一点的话……我可不管了哦……
en: Mm... any higher... and I won’t be responsible for what happens...

zh_CN: 嗯……手掌热乎乎的……还挺舒服嘛。
en: Mm... your palm’s so warm... that feels nice.

zh_CN: 唔……干嘛突然这么温柔地摸我的脸呀……
en: Mm... why are you suddenly stroking my face so gently...

zh_CN: 唔……嗯……再亲深一点嘛，隆司……
en: Mm... mm... kiss me deeper, Ryuji...

zh_CN: 哈啊……刚才想逗你的话……全被你堵回去了……
en: Hah... all the things I was going to tease you with... you’ve kissed them away...

zh_CN: 啊……别、别一直亲脖子……耳根都烫透了……
en: Ah... d-don’t keep kissing my neck... even my ears are burning...

zh_CN: ……唔，隆司……你越来越知道怎么收拾我了……
en: ...Mm, Ryuji... you’re getting better at putting me in my place...

zh_CN: 呀……！……咬、咬脖子算是犯规啦……！
en: Ah...!... B-biting my neck is cheating...!

zh_CN: 啊……真敢下嘴呀……留印子了我可找你算账……
en: Ah... you really did bite me... I’ll get you for it if you leave a mark...

zh_CN: 呀啊……！那、那里不能咬得这么坏心眼……
en: Ahh...! D-don’t bite me there so wickedly...

zh_CN: 唔……隆司……轻、轻一点……太刺激了……
en: Mm... Ryuji... g-gently... that’s too intense...

zh_CN: 嗯……顺着腰摸下来……身体都软了……
en: Mm... stroking down my waist... my whole body’s going limp...

zh_CN: 呼……你的手……比平时检查时还烫呢……
en: Hah... your hands... are warmer than when you examine me...

zh_CN: 咦……怎、怎么突然舔脸颊呀，小狗吗？
en: Huh... wh-why are you licking my cheek all of a sudden? Are you a puppy?

zh_CN: 哎呀……湿漉漉的，好痒啦！
en: Oh... it’s all wet. That tickles!

zh_CN: 痛……唔，连嘴唇也咬？你学坏了哦。
en: Ow... mm, you’re biting my lips too? You’re getting naughty.

zh_CN: 哼……这是在报复我平时逗你吗？
en: Hmph... is this payback for all the times I tease you?

zh_CN: 唔……咬脸颊干嘛呀，傻瓜。
en: Mm... why are you biting my cheek, silly?

zh_CN: 哎呀……我脸皮可没你那么厚哦。
en: Oh... my skin isn’t as thick as yours, you know.

zh_CN: 呀……！等、等一下，那里可不兴用咬的！
en: Ah...! W-wait, you’re not supposed to bite there!

zh_CN: 唔……太乱来了啦，换个温柔点的！
en: Mm... that’s too much. Try something gentler!

zh_CN: 唔……好痒！别拿舌头逗那边啦……
en: Mm... that tickles! Don’t tease me there with your tongue...

zh_CN: 哎呀……肚子一直缩，你故意的吧？
en: Oh... my belly keeps twitching. You’re doing that on purpose, aren’t you?

zh_CN: 门反锁好了？……哼哼，今晚的诊疗室归我们两个人了。
en: Did you lock the door?... Hehe, the examination room belongs to just the two of us tonight.

zh_CN: 白大褂先别急着挂远嘛……过来，今天你想谁先检查谁？
en: Don’t put your white coat too far away yet... come here. Who do you want to examine whom first today?

zh_CN: 嘘……外头走廊早没人了。过来，隆司，今晚不准按铃叫别人哦。
en: Shh... the corridor outside has been empty for ages. Come here, Ryuji. No ringing for anyone else tonight.

zh_CN: 平时在这里替病人做准备，和你在里头锁上门胡闹……感觉还真不一样呢。
en: Preparing patients here every day, and locking ourselves in here to fool around... it really does feel different.

zh_CN: 嘘……门锁好了？平时在这儿查房，今天倒轮到我们关起门来胡闹了。
en: Shh... is the door locked? Usually we make rounds here. Today it’s our turn to shut the door and fool around.

zh_CN: 小声点哦，隆司……这儿可跟外头的俱乐部不一样。
en: Keep your voice down, Ryuji... this isn’t like a club outside the hospital.

zh_CN: 哼哼……连医院都不用回，今晚可没借口逃跑了哦。
en: Hehe... we don’t even have to go back to the hospital. No excuses to run away tonight.

zh_CN: 过来吧，隆司……今天你想怎么被我检查？
en: Come here, Ryuji... how would you like me to examine you today?

zh_CN: 进来吧……先说好，乱丢的衣服不准笑话我哦。
en: Come in... but no laughing at the clothes I’ve left lying around.

zh_CN: 唔……在自己房间里，反倒比在诊疗室里还要害羞一点呢。
en: Mm... being in my own room makes me a little more embarrassed than being in the examination room.

zh_CN: 连无影灯下都敢拉我进来……你的胆子真是越来越大了。
en: You even dare pull me under the surgical lights... you’re getting bolder and bolder.

zh_CN: 嘘……别出声，让我看看主刀医生私底下有多不规矩。
en: Shh... not a sound. Let me see how badly the surgeon behaves in private.

zh_CN: 啊……一上来就这么不客气……
en: Ah... so rough right from the start...

zh_CN: 唔……抱紧我，隆司……别光看着我笑……
en: Mm... hold me tight, Ryuji... don’t just smile at me...

zh_CN: 哈啊……明明平时都是我逗你……今天全让你占上风了……
en: Hah... usually I’m the one teasing you... today you have the upper hand...

zh_CN: 啊……嗯……太、太深了……隆司……
en: Ah... mm... t-too deep... Ryuji...

zh_CN: 唔……别、别停……我今天可不打算认输……
en: Mm... d-don’t stop... I’m not going to admit defeat today...

zh_CN: 哈啊……等、等一下……连声音都管不住了……
en: Hah... w-wait... I can’t even control my voice...

zh_CN: 哈啊……浑身都没力气了……你得负责抱紧我……
en: Hah... I haven’t got any strength left... you’ll have to hold me tight...

zh_CN: 唔……先别说话……让我靠着你缓一口气……
en: Mm... don’t say anything yet... let me lean against you and catch my breath...

zh_CN: 嗯……坏家伙……这下满意了吧……
en: Mm... you rascal... satisfied now...?

zh_CN: 哈啊……够、够了啦……别光在外面逗我了，隆司……快点进来嘛……
en: Hah... e-enough... stop just teasing me on the outside, Ryuji... come inside already...

zh_CN: 嗯……真乖……就这样慢慢进来，抱紧我……
en: Mm... good boy... come in slowly, just like that, and hold me tight...

zh_CN: 呀啊……！……隆司，你今天怎么这么凶呀……！
en: Ahh...!... Ryuji, why are you so rough today...!

zh_CN: 唔……再近一点……连指甲都要抓不住你了……
en: Mm... a little closer... I can barely hold on to you, even with my nails...

zh_CN: 啊……等、等一下……节奏全被你抢走了啦……！
en: Ah... w-wait... you’ve taken over the rhythm completely...!

zh_CN: 啊啊……隆司……！
en: Ahh... Ryuji...!

zh_CN: 呀啊……不、不行了……！
en: Ahh... I-I can’t take it...!

zh_CN: 唔……太、太深了啊啊……！
en: Mm... t-too deep, ahh...!

zh_CN: 哈啊……全、全都进来吧……！
en: Hah... g-give me all of it...!

zh_CN: 哈啊……明明平时都是我捉弄你，一到这种时候就全让你讨回去了……
en: Hah... I’m usually the one teasing you, but whenever we do this you get me back for everything...

zh_CN: 别急着起身去整理诊疗台嘛……再抱我两分钟，这是护士小姐的特批哦。
en: Don’t get up to tidy the examination table just yet... hold me for two more minutes. Special permission from your nurse.

zh_CN: 要射了！
en: I’m coming!

zh_CN: 要来了……！
en: It’s coming...!

zh_CN: 忍不住了……！
en: I can’t hold back...!

zh_CN: 就是现在！
en: Right now!

zh_CN: 一起到吧！
en: Let’s come together!

zh_CN: 温柔进入
en: Enter gently

zh_CN: 粗暴进入
en: Enter roughly
